prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for most change types, as only adoption new_flow, home new_flow, sign_in hint, and choose_path copy have been tested more than once.
choose_path copy changes showed no clear effect across both completed tests.
home new_flow and sign_in hint are helpful change types that delivered wins, though one home new_flow test showed no clear effect.
adoption new_flow can be helpful but yields inconsistent results, producing one win and two tests with no clear effect.
Predictions were generally too high across tests, but consistently underestimated results for home new_flow.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +0.2% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: -0.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +1.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, hint: -1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, layout: -0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +0.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: +3.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: -0.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: +3.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, incentive: -3.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -1.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 63.3%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 87.9%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.9%

Changes:
0: [home, redesign] Stage Waiting Status Redesign: Redesign the waiting screen into a stage layout featuring live setup status, time estimates, and step counters. (why: The home waiting step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s with 12.1% drop-off. Lessons show home redesigns and status clarity consistently drive wins.)
1: [finish, new_screen] First Desk Interaction Welcome Screen: Add a new screen following onboarding completion to introduce desktop hotkeys and window interaction controls. (why: Finish step has a low 64.8% completion rate and support received 3 tickets from users confused about controlling, hiding, or talking to their pet.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Guided Photo Upload Companion Flow: Rebuild the photo upload screen with a split layout detailing photo lighting requirements and upload progress indicators. (why: Adoption step drops to 63.3% conversion and support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failures or distorted results.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Account Sign-In Placement: Move sign-in step after adoption certificate creation so users design their pet before registering an account. (why: Sign-in currently occurs at step 2 before users build emotional investment in their pet, creating unnecessary early friction.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Sync Hint: Display an informative hint on the sign-in screen assuring users that logging in restores their existing desktop pets. (why: Support received 8 emails reporting missing or reset pets after signing in, making sign-in reassurance critical.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Environment Readiness Wait Status: Add real-time environment readiness status text to the waiting screen while desktop pet assets load. (why: Home waiting has a high mean time of 2336s and support received 3 tickets where pets failed to appear on the desktop.)
6: [finish, notification] Desktop Launch Completion Notification: Add a system notification opt-in toggle on the home intro screen so users are notified when pet spawning finishes. (why: Long wait times during home generation (median 201s) lead users to switch windows or drop off before pet placement.)
7: [adoption, incentive] Certificate Name Personalization Incentive: Add an official adoption badge and visual component to the certificate screen to highlight companion naming. (why: Adoption has the lowest step conversion rate (63.3%), making visual rewards effective for completing setup.)
8: [choose_path, copy] Story Scroll Companion Narrative Copy: Update the story screen to a story_scroll layout with copy focusing on interactive desktop presence. (why: The initial path choice takes a median of 8s but mean of 514s, indicating some users stall on early context screens.)
